content: input-leap drag-and-drop file transfer is widely reported broken across Windows/macOS/Linux (issues #258, #226, #378, #855) — dragging a file between screens can hard-lock the cursor. Deskflow's own maintainers removed drag-and-drop entirely because 'it never worked reliably.' Clipboard sharing works on Windows/macOS but is NOT supported on Linux/Wayland in input-leap. This is strong evidence that clipboard/DnD/file-transfer are separable, high-defect-rate features that even funded, multi-year projects fail to deliver reliably on Linux — validates ilhop's exclusion.
